moral_text: Quiet, steady care can save more than grand gestures.
A tradition's worth is the hope it carries, not the tool it uses.
Those who seize credit are forgotten; those who light the way endure.
A small light kept burning is a promise that someone still cares.
True service is often unseen and unthanked, yet it holds a community together.
Kindness offered in the dark outlives the one who offers it.
